1.0 Design Inputs

Compacted Hardfill/Ground Improvement Properties

The base interface value is calculated from the hardfill strength and interface reduction factor. Confirm the adopted parameters and applicability for the project.

For multilayer scenarios, add weighted-average soil properties.

Design considers vertical load V and moment M to act at the centre of the footing (B/2). Entered structure weights exclude footing self-weight Wc. Design axial loads include Wc.

3.0 Bearing Capacity Factors

Bearing capacity factors are calculated using NZ B1/VM2 (2025) method, except compressibility factors, which use Vesic (1973) method.
